dog.description_text:
AGE / WEIGHT: 2.5 years old / 53 lbs

GENDER: Female

ENERGY: Moderate

GOOD WITH: Dogs - Yes, Kids - TBD, Cats - TBD

ABOUT ME: New place? New people? Car ride? Bath? Bring it on. I roll with almost everything, and then the zoomies go off, so stand back. I’m curious about it all, I like pets, and I never say no to a soft treat. I catch on fast, and my Kong and I are inseparable. New dogs get a polite sniff. Brooklyn, save your applause for the finale.

MY FOSTER SAYS: My story is still being written. Check back soon for updates!

HISTORY

Firework came into a small local shelter in Georgia as a stray and appeared to have had puppies. She traveled to Brooklyn in late October 2026.

DETAILED PROFILE

Firework takes new things in stride. When our team met her at a small shelter in Georgia, she was curious about everything nearby, and then the fuse ran out: big zoomies and a burst of friendliness toward the people around her. She was just as happy to stop and accept some pets, and she has shown herself to be very adaptable.

The people caring for her in Georgia describe a dog who catches on fast and listens well, so well that they suspect someone taught her a thing or two along the way. She never potties in her kennel, was perfect for her bath, and doesn’t chew what she shouldn’t. She loves her Kong and soft treats, and she found her car ride more interesting than alarming.

She also has good dog manners. On a walk with another dog, the two noted each other and carried on with no fuss. When they were allowed to say hello, they traded casual, appropriate sniffs and then shared the space easily. She doesn’t really bark at other dogs unless they bark first, in which case she will offer a rebuttal. She walks well on leash and was fine being handled.

All of this comes from her time in Georgia, so consider it an early read. Her energy at home, crate and house training, city leash manners, and how she does with kids and cats are still unknown. A new home will mean an adjustment period and some training along the way.

Anyone who appreciates a smart girl with good manners and a flair for zoomies should keep an eye on the sky. She’s just getting started.

MEDICAL HISTORY

The dogs in our care are up-to-date on vaccinations, spayed or neutered (when old enough), microchipped, and given a general health check. Immediate medical needs and medical history will be addressed with the adopter prior to adoption. Complete vet records will be sent shortly after adoption.
dog.name: FIREWORK
